subject: Re: Air freight quote request for RUH and DXB
body:
Thank you for your offer. Both prices work for us. Please go ahead and book the first shipment now; we will confirm the second shipment later.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer accepts both quoted prices and asks us to book the first shipment.
